issues.quote: up only 12.6% from $96.8 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Going from $96.8B to $97.7B is roughly 0.9% growth, not 12.6%.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly correct, but it has one error: it calls revenue growth 12.6% when the real figure is about 0.9%. The other figures match Tesla's reported FY2023 and FY2024 numbers.
